channel.title: Pajhwok Afghan News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: Pakistan orders closure of Afghan refugee camp in Sawabi
item.description: Pakistani authorities have closed all shops in the Afghan refugee camp Gohati in Sawabi district, notifying Afghan nationals that the camp has officially been terminated.

item.title: Nearly 7,000 returnees secured jobs, 166,000 registered for employment
item.description: The Committee for Providing Employment Opportunities to Returnees has facilitated jobs for around 7,000 returnees and registered over 166,000 for employment, an official said on Wednesday.

item.title: Afghan, Turkmen officials discuss standardizing oil, gas exports
item.description: The Director of the Afghanistan Standard and Quality Authority (ASQA), Mawlawi Faizullah Tamim, held discussions with Turkmen officials to strengthen cooperation in the standardization of goods and the export of Turkmen oil and gas to Afghanistan based on established standards.

item.title: High-tonnage weighbridge system installed in Maidan Wardak
item.description: The Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Technology (MoCIT) announced that a modern, standards-compliant high-tonnage weighbridge system has been installed and is now operational in coordination with the Ministry of Public Works in central Maidan Wardak Province.

item.title: 23 domestic standards approved to boost quality control
item.description: KABUL (Pajhwok): The Afghanistan Standards and Quality Authority (ASQA) announced that the Economic Commission has approved draft documents for 23 domestic standards and testing procedures.

item.title: Iran, US to begin 3rd round of talks in Switzerland
item.description: Iran and the United States are due to begin a third round of nuclear negotiations in Switzerland today (Thursday), Al Jazeera reported.

item.title: Sri Lanka crash out of T20 World Cup after defeat by New Zealand
item.description: Co-hosts Sri Lanka have been knocked out of the T20 World Cup after slumping to a comprehensive 61-run defeat against New Zealand in Colombo.

item.title: Work begins on 2 canals in Logar with nearly $400,000 investment
item.description: Construction has commenced on the Wazir Qala and Khwaja Angoor canals in central Logar province, the Ministry of Energy and Water announced on Thursday.

item.title: 4 killed as shootout between Cuban forces, US-tagged speedboat
item.description: Four people have been killed by Cuban border patrol forces in a shootout with a US-registered speedboat, according to media reports on Thursday.

item.title: Pakistan must face consequences for its shameful actions: Mujahid
item.description: The Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan (IEA) has slammed Pakistan for targeting civilians in airstrikes on Afghan territory, stating that Islamabad must face consequences for its shameful act.
